enabled.title: Enable MemOS
enabled.description: Turn the MemOS long-term memory system on or off

api_url.title: MemOS API URL
api_url.description: Address of the MemOS backend, default http://127.0.0.1:8003

auto_inject.title: Inject memories automatically
auto_inject.description: Finds related memories during chats and adds them to the system prompt

inject_top_k.title: Memories to inject
inject_top_k.description: Max number of memories added each time

similarity_threshold.title: Similarity threshold
similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity (0 to 1) for a memory to be added

auto_save.title: Save chats automatically
auto_save.description: Collects chats and saves them to long-term memory after LLM replies

save_interval.title: Save interval (turns)
save_interval.description: Saves memories to the backend in a batch every this many turns

backend_llm.title: Backend LLM settings
backend_llm.description: LLM that the MemOS backend uses to summarize chats and extract entities (not the chat model)

model.title: Model name
model.description: LLM model used for backend memory processing

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: API key of the backend LLM

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: API URL of the backend LLM

max_tokens.title: Max output tokens
max_tokens.description: Output token budget for backend memory/entity extraction (2000-8000 recommended)

backend_llm_fallback.title: Backend fallback LLM
backend_llm_fallback.description: Model settings used when the main LLM fails

enabled.title: Enable fallback LLM
enabled.description: Switch to the fallback model when the main LLM call fails

api_key.title: Fallback API Key
api_key.description: API key of the fallback LLM

base_url.title: Fallback Base URL
base_url.description: API URL of the fallback LLM

backend_search.title: Backend search settings
backend_search.description: Hybrid search settings of the MemOS backend

enable_bm25.title: Enable BM25 hybrid search
enable_bm25.description: Combines vector search with BM25 keyword search to find more memories

bm25_weight.title: BM25 weight
bm25_weight.description: Weight of BM25 in hybrid search (0 to 1). The vector weight is 1 minus this value

enable_graph_query.title: Enable knowledge graph boost
enable_graph_query.description: Uses the entity relation graph to expand search results

enable_reranker.title: Enable CrossEncoder reranking
enable_reranker.description: Reranks the first-pass results a second time. The model is large, so leave it off on low-end PCs.

reranker_auto_download.title: Download the rerank model automatically
reranker_auto_download.description: If reranking is on and the model is missing, the MemOS backend downloads BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 when it starts.

reranker_model_id.title: Rerank model ID
reranker_model_id.description: ModelScope/Hugging Face model ID. The default is the multilingual bge-reranker-v2-m3.

reranker_model_path.title: Rerank model local path
reranker_model_path.description: Folder where the model is downloaded and loaded from. The default is full-hub/reranker-hub in the project folder.

rerank_top_n.title: Rerank candidates
rerank_top_n.description: How many first-pass results go to CrossEncoder reranking.

backend_embedding.title: Backend embedding and rerank models
backend_embedding.description: How the two memory search models run. Local models: run on your GPU, use about 2 GB+ VRAM, searches take milliseconds. API calls: use SiliconFlow's BAAI/bge-m3 and BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, use no VRAM, add about 1 second per search, and send memory text to the cloud. Both use the same models, so switching does not require rebuilding the memory store. Rerun 4.MEMOS-API.bat after changing this.

provider.title: Run mode
provider.description: Local models or API calls. The embedding model and the reranker switch together. Reranking is still controlled by "Enable CrossEncoder reranking" above.

options.label: API calls (no VRAM, about 1 second slower)

api_base_url.title: API URL
api_base_url.description: SiliconFlow China endpoint https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 (do not use the international .com endpoint). Only used with "API calls".

api_key.title: API Key
api_key.description: SiliconFlow API key. If empty, the memory system starts with local models even when API calls are selected, and shows a notice.

embedding_model.title: Embedding model name (usually leave as is)
embedding_model.description: Must be BAAI/bge-m3, the same as the local model, or old and new memory vectors will not match.

rerank_model.title: Rerank model name (usually leave as is)
rerank_model.description: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, the same as the local model.

backend_features.title: Backend features
backend_features.description: Advanced features of the MemOS backend

entity_extraction.title: Extract entities automatically
entity_extraction.description: When a memory is added, extracts names, places and other entities into the knowledge graph

image_memory.title: Image memory
image_memory.description: Enables image memories such as image uploads and saved screenshots

image_auto_describe.title: Describe images automatically
image_auto_describe.description: Uses the LLM to write a description when an image is uploaded
